race.comment: CONCORD CONNIE (4) is the clear standout in the last. She wasn't given much hope in two runs to start the campaign but the market stuck fat with her in the G1 Empire Rose and she was outstanding in defeat to Lady Shenandoah as a $6.50 hope. Wouldn't want them to be too cute from the wide gate but the pace looks genuine and if she runs to anything like that level she should make a mess of them. SAVITRI (10) won in fast time two back then chased a hot speed again behind Surfin' Bird last time. She maps well and will give the favourite something to chase. TERILEE (7) did beat CONCORD CONNIE home by a nose in the Tristarc at Caulfield, albeit CONCORD CONNIE was a far superior run given where she got to. An extra 100m suits. SUPERFABULISTIC (12) was dominant winning on Champions Day from the front and should give a sight.
